svg.text: How AutoDiscovery findings become validated reports, frozen detectors, and an evolved candidate scorer

text.tspan: · GT supplies labels and audits, never features
· agents judge artifacts; drivers run, measure, validate
· each stage consumes frozen, provenance-checked outputs

svg.text: Run detector on a compute node
later, separately, on the full brain:
→ OOF scores · fitted joblib · model manifest
Generation loop · one kind per generation, alternating merge / split
archive = champion + specialists + protected reference · repeated stalls force exploration, then pause
